note: LegiScan people_id to VoteApp candidate id for Michigan's 103rd Legislature. The dataset holds 148 people, which is exactly the 110 House seats plus the 38 Senate seats. 113 are mapped and 35 are explicit nulls. The resolver proposed all 113 and every one was accepted after review. 108 matched on both names and 5 on a first-name prefix, all five being an ordinary short form (Curtis to Curt, Matthew to Matt) on a candidate holding the same district. 11 proposals carry a seat disagreement and all 11 are real: ten are sitting House members running for a Senate seat, which is ordinary in Michigan because all 38 Senate seats are on the 2026 ballot and House members are term-limited, and one is Senator Dayna Polehanki, whose seat is SD-005 in the LegiScan roster and State Senate District 8 in our district records. Each of the 11 was checked against the candidate's own election record. The 35 nulls are legislators with no November 2026 candidacy in the database. 20 are senators and 15 are representatives, and Michigan's term limits are why: a legislator who has served 12 years cannot run again. Each of the 35 was searched by surname across every Michigan November 2026 race, not only the legislative ones, and none matched. One limit worth recording: Michigan's Governor, United States Senator and United States Representative elections exist in the database for November 2026 but hold no candidates at all. A legislator running for one of those offices therefore cannot be reached today. Senator Mallory McMorrow, who is running for the United States Senate, is the notable case. Revisit this file if those rosters are filled.
